components.name: PersonasPanel

props.name: initialId
props.desc: Persona to preselect; defaults to the first in the store.

props.name: onClose
props.desc: Called when the page is dismissed from a host shell.

whenUse: The full CRUD surface for the persona library.
Mounted as a workspace tab — it owns list + editor state.
whenNot: Picking a persona inline — use PersonaList alone.
Read-only display — render PersonaRow without the form.

components.name: AgentsBoard

props.name: agents
props.desc: The running agents to tile, one AgentTile each.

props.name: onOpen
props.desc: Drill into an agent's session.

whenUse: An at-a-glance grid of every agent built from a persona.
The read-only fleet overview next to the Personas page.
whenNot: Editing a persona — that is PersonasPanel's job.
A single agent's detail — render one AgentTile expanded.

components.name: PersonaShell

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title, rendered as the DemoHeading.

props.name: children
props.desc: The main detail column.

props.name: rail
props.desc: Optional left rail (list/navigation); omitted → single column.

whenUse: The one page frame both demo pages mount — header + optional rail + detail.
Any new page in this app, so chrome stays identical.
whenNot: Inside another PersonaShell — the shell never nests.
A modal or overlay — this is the page-level frame only.

components.name: PersonaList

props.name: personas
props.desc: The personas to list, one PersonaRow each.

props.name: onPick
props.desc: Row click → selection.

props.name: activeId
props.desc: The highlighted row.

whenUse: The selectable persona rail — search field over PersonaRows.
Anywhere a persona must be picked from the library.
whenNot: A read-only mention of one persona — use PersonaRow.
Editing — pair it with PersonaForm via PersonasPanel.

components.name: PersonaRow

props.name: persona
props.desc: The persona to render — badge, name, role tag.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Select this row.

props.name: active
props.desc: Highlight as the current selection.

whenUse: One persona in any list — the ONLY persona row in the app.
Compact mentions that must stay visually consistent.
whenNot: The full editable record — that is PersonaForm.
A dense table — use a plain text cell, not a row card.

components.name: PersonaForm

props.name: value
props.desc: The persona being edited (a draft copy).

props.name: onSave
props.desc: Commit the draft to the store.

props.name: onDelete
props.desc: Remove the persona; omitted → no danger button.

whenUse: The persona editor — name/prompt fields plus save/delete.
The detail column of PersonasPanel.
whenNot: Displaying a persona — use PersonaRow or AgentTile.
Bulk edits — drive PersonaStore directly instead.

components.name: AgentTile

props.name: agent
props.desc: The agent — persona identity plus live status.

props.name: onOpen
props.desc: Click-through to the agent's session.

whenUse: One agent on the AgentsBoard grid — identity + status.
A compact live card wherever an agent is summarized.
whenNot: Editing the underlying persona — go to PersonasPanel.
Long-form logs — this card shows status, not output.

components.name: DemoButton

props.name: children
props.desc: The button label.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Visual weight; defaults to ghost.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler (omit for type=submit).

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

whenUse: EVERY clickable action in the app — the one button.
primary = the single main action; danger = destructive.
whenNot: Navigation — use a link, not a button.
A raw <button> — forbidden by this kit's lint rule.

components.name: DemoField

props.name: label
props.desc: Uppercase field label above the input.

props.name: value
props.desc: Controlled value.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: Change handler (already unwrapped from the event).

props.name: error
props.desc: Validation message; tints the border red.

whenUse: Every single-line text input — label + input + error slot.
Search boxes and form fields alike, so spacing matches.
whenNot: Multi-line text — this wraps a single <input> only.
A raw <input> — forbidden by this kit's lint rule.

components.name: RoleTag

props.name: role
props.desc: The persona role — picks the tag's tone.

props.name: compact
props.desc: Dot-only rendering for tight rows.

whenUse: Labelling a persona/agent with its role, everywhere.
One tone per role, so the color IS the meaning.
whenNot: Free-form tags — this is the closed role set only.
Status (running/paused) — that is the tile's status dot.

components.name: PersonaBadge

rules.message: Render identities with the kit's <PersonaBadge>, not an avatar library — one identity mark, zero dependencies. If truly required, add `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-imports -- <reason>`.

props.name: name
props.desc: Persona name — the badge derives its initials + hue.

props.name: size
props.desc: Diameter in px; defaults to 28.

whenUse: The identity mark for a persona or agent, everywhere.
Deterministic initials + hue — no image assets needed.
whenNot: Human users with real photos — this is persona-only.
Pulling in an avatar library — forbidden by the kit rule.

components.name: DemoHeading

props.name: children
props.desc: The heading text.

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dim secondary text after the title.

whenUse: Every page/section title — one type scale for the app.
Composed by PersonaShell so page headers never drift.
whenNot: Body copy or labels — plain text elements are fine.
A raw <h2> — forbidden by this kit's lint rule.

components.name: PersonaStore

props.name: usePersonas()
props.desc: The React hook every consumer mounts — live list + writers.

props.name: save(p)
props.desc: Upsert one persona through the `bsc persona` bridge.

props.name: remove(id)
props.desc: Delete a persona from the global store.

props.name: subscribe(fn)
props.desc: Out-of-React change feed; returns the unsubscribe.

whenUse: ALL persona reads/writes — the one data service, mounted by the page (PersonasPanel), never by leaves.
Composed like any component: the page passes its data down.
whenNot: UI state (selection, drafts) — that stays in the page.
Calling the CLI directly from a component — always via this.
